Careers

Their expertise is the edge.
We're turning it into AI.

Pelles transforms trade contractors' knowledge, documents, and workflows into AI-powered systems — so projects run the way their best people would. For years construction software flattened every contractor into the same shape: a generic GC, an engineering firm, a general-purpose sub. It was never for them. We're building the platform that finally fits.

We're looking for the rare engineers, scientists, designers, and operators who want to ship software a 30-year superintendent will reach for and trust. The work is specific: RFIs grounded in sheet citations, submittals checked against spec paragraphs, schedules that answer questions, pay applications validated line by line. Real workflows, real customers, real impact this month.
